findings.title: Fix the invalid ERB block terminator
findings.body: The opening if/else block is closed with `end if` rather than `end`. The trailing `if` has no condition, so the generated Ruby cannot compile. Requests that find an existing embedded topic will fail while rendering this template instead of displaying the discussion. The controller specs do not render views, so they do not catch this failure.

findings.title: Sanitize raw HTML before storing it as cooked content
findings.body: This branch returns HTML unchanged, but the feed import path does not sanitize it: PollFeed decodes feed content, and TopicEmbed only parses it to rewrite URLs. Script tags, event-handler attributes, and javascript links can therefore survive into `post.cooked`, which the embed view renders with `raw` on the forum's origin. Edits to imported posts retain the same sanitization bypass. Raw HTML rendering must still apply an HTML safety policy to prevent stored XSS.

findings.title: Handle standard RSS description and encoded-content fields
findings.body: The poller assumes every item has an Atom-style `content` field. Standard RSS items commonly provide `description` or `content:encoded` instead; SimpleRSS exposes those separately, leaving `i.content` nil. Calling `scrub` then raises and aborts the entire poll, so ordinary RSS feeds cannot be imported. Select the available content field and handle entries with no body.

findings.title: Validate redirect destinations during remote retrieval
findings.body: TopicRetriever checks only the initial URL against `embeddable_host`, while `open(url)` follows HTTP redirects without applying that restriction again. An allowed-host URL that redirects to another host, including a private HTTP service, causes the forum server to fetch that destination and potentially publish its HTML under the original allowed URL. Validate the scheme and destination of every redirect before issuing the next request.

findings.title: Resolve relative URLs using standard URL semantics
findings.body: The URL rewriting treats every leading slash as a path on the article host. A protocol-relative resource such as `//cdn.example.com/image.png` consequently becomes `http://blog.example/cdn.example.com/image.png`. Conversely, path-relative resources such as `images/image.png` are left unchanged and resolve against the forum rather than the source article. Both links and images are affected. Resolve relative references against the article URL while preserving protocol-relative hosts.

findings.title: Defer post jobs and publication until the outer transaction commits
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import wraps PostCreator.create in an outer transaction. PostCreator enqueues feature-topic-users and process-post jobs, and publishes the new-topic event, after its own nested transaction returns—but that does not commit this outer transaction. Workers can therefore receive IDs before the corresponding rows are visible, and a subsequent TopicEmbed creation failure can roll back rows whose jobs and events have already been emitted. Defer these side effects until the outermost transaction commits.

findings.title: Preserve exported thread timestamps in Disqus imports
findings.body: The previous topic creation passed the Disqus thread's `created_at`, but the replacement passes only its title. TopicEmbed.import_remote does not propagate a creation timestamp, so imported topics are now created with the current time while their comments still retain historical exported dates. This produces topics whose creation date is later than their replies and loses the original thread chronology. Pass the exported timestamp through the embed importer to PostCreator.
